title: Raise Anthropic's default max_tokens from 256 to 16,000

files.patch:
@@ -10,6 +10,7 @@
 - [SECURITY]: A change which fixes a security vulnerability.
 
 ## [Unreleased]
+- [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1073] Raise `Langchain::LLM::Anthropic`'s default `max_tokens` from 256 to 16,000; Claude Sonnet 5 and later, Haiku 5.5 and Opus 5 and later think by default within that cap, so they often stopped before writing any text and `#chat_completion` returned `nil`.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1072] Ask the LLM with `#chat` in `Langchain::Chunker::Semantic`, the Ragas evals and `Vectorsearch::Base#similarity_search_with_hyde`; they called `#complete`, which Google Gemini, Vertex AI and Mistral AI don't implement, and the semantic chunker passed `max_tokens_to_sample:`, which `Langchain::LLM::Anthropic#complete` rejected.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1069] Honor `tables:` and `exclude_tables:` in `Langchain::Tool::Database#list_tables` and `#dump_schema`, list the key columns of a composite primary key, and drop the trailing comma from the schema of a table without a primary key.
 - [BUGFIX] [https://github.com/patterns-ai-core/langchainrb/pull/1071] Use the loader's `chunker:` for every file of a directory loaded with `Langchain::Loader`, and match file extensions case-insensitively, so `NOTES.TXT` no longer raises `UnknownFormatError`.

@@ -15,7 +15,9 @@ class Anthropic < Base
       temperature: 0.0,
       completion_model: "claude-2.1",
       chat_model: "claude-sonnet-4-6",
-      max_tokens: 256
+      # Claude Sonnet 5 and later, Haiku 5.5 and Opus 5 and later think by default, and the thinking
+      # counts against max_tokens: with a small cap they can stop on "max_tokens" before writing any text.
+      max_tokens: 16_000
     }.freeze
 
     # Initialize an Anthropic LLM instance

@@ -80,6 +80,25 @@
     let(:fixture) { File.read("spec/fixtures/llm/anthropic/chat.json") }
     let(:response) { JSON.parse(fixture, symbolize_names: true) }
 
+    context "with max_tokens" do
+      it "leaves room for the thinking that current Claude models do by default" do
+        expect(subject.client.messages).to receive(:create)
+          .with(hash_including(max_tokens: 16_000))
+          .and_return(response)
+
+        subject.chat(messages: messages)
+      end
+
+      it "sends a max_tokens set in default_options" do
+        llm = described_class.new(api_key: "123", default_options: {max_tokens: 1024})
+        expect(llm.client.messages).to receive(:create)
+          .with(hash_including(max_tokens: 1024))
+          .and_return(response)
+
+        llm.chat(messages: messages)
+      end
+    end
+
     context "with temperature" do
       it "does not send the library's default temperature, which current Claude models reject" do
